description: Fast-follows specled_-k6s ([EPIC] Impromptu: 0.11.0 fast-follow sweep), shipped as PR #32 / release 0.11.0 / main c2d21349. Split out at delivery so the shipped epic could close without orphaning live work. Carries the three children that did not land plus one coupled standalone follow-up. NOTE: the dn4.12 and vbo branches are based on 2d4535c1, which is NOT an ancestor of the squashed main. Rebase onto main before resuming, and use a cold rebase worker rather than hand-resolving.

comments.text:
DELIVERY INCIDENT — false close_reason from a concurrent session (2026-07-28)

While /deliver was re-homing children into this epic, a DIFFERENT Claude session
(transcript 2c08579a-c8b0-4a0f-9491-d5feaae408f7, last written 09:17:57 EDT)
ran a batch of closes at 13:02:13-13:02:15Z, all carrying:

  close_reason: "Shipped in k6s epic PR (release 0.11.0, c2d21349)."

For three of them that statement is FALSE:

  specled_-dn4.12  reverted from the epic branch after an INTEGRATION_REGRESSION;
                   its 3 commits live only on specled_-dn4.12/coverage-source-resolver
                   @ 400839c3 and are NOT on main.
  specled_-vbo     never landed; parked with bounce cap exhausted.
  specled_-zd8     never started; was blocked behind dn4.12.

Verified against the tree: `git diff refs/pull/32/head c2d21349` is empty, so
the squash shipped exactly the 24 PR commits and nothing else. None of the three
is among them.

REPAIRED: statuses restored to in_progress / in_progress / open, and zd8's
blocked_by:dn4.12 edge came back with it.

NOT REPAIRED: the stale `closed_at` and `close_reason` fields persist on all
three records — bw does not clear them on status restore. Any later reader
querying --json will see a closed_at timestamp and a false shipping claim on a
ticket whose status is open. This is the same defect class already tracked by
specled_-s4a (false close_reason on -8qg, -pj8, -5ui) — and notably that same
session closed those three ids again in this batch.

ALSO CLOSED by that session, OUT OF SCOPE for this delivery and left untouched
pending human review: specled_-k6s (the epic itself), specled_-xkn, specled_-isr,
specled_-mkl, specled_-qvg, specled_-dn4.13, specled_-5ui, specled_-8qg,
specled_-pj8. Some may be legitimate duplicate-closes (5ui duplicates zd8's
title, pj8 duplicates npo's, 8qg is the n5s KeyError that shipped in 0.10.0) but
none was verified here.

Worktree teardown (17 merged stage worktrees, FORCE=1) was APPROVED by the
operator but is HELD — not executed — because a second agent was mutating this
repo within the last 20 minutes and FORCE=1 is unrecoverable.
Split from specled_-k6s at delivery; the original shipped as PR #32 / release 0.11.0 / main c2d21349. Carries specled_-dn4.12, specled_-vbo, specled_-zd8, specled_-bos.
